basic_info.description: Timeless San Francisco charm meets refined livability in this grand full-floor Victorian flat located in Noe Valley-meets the sunny Mission Dolores. Spanning 1,695 sq. ft. (per graphic designer), the current floor plan supports a 3-bedroom residence featuring soaring tall ceilings, period details, and an elegant layout flowing seamlessly to a south-facing garden courtyard (shared). The spacious kitchen with stainless steel appliances opens to a bright dining area, while a central hallway connects three well-proportioned bedrooms and a full bath, with a luminous double-parlor in the front. Enjoy exclusive private storage, central heating, and expansion potential.  Ideally situated on a tree-lined street near Dolores Park, Valencia Street, and many celebrated eateries. Set in San Francisco's sunniest microclimate, this A+ location blends everyday ease with the best of city living; excellent transit, walkability, nearby tech shuttles. Start your day with coffee from Ritual, stroll to Dolores Park, and wind down with dinner on Valencia Streetall just steps from your front door.
